title: grid inline edit: an extra column also titled "Actions" appears, a click without a change marks the row modified, and the toggle has no pressed state
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: showcase Tasks grid → *Edit inline*.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the console / records owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of the end-user console on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue，然后继续测试前端」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

- Turning inline edit on adds a second column whose header is also **Actions** (larger type than the first); it holds the per-row cancel/save icons.
- Clicking then double-clicking a Priority cell without choosing a new value shows "1 row modified · Cancel All · Save All (1)"; the server value is unchanged.
- The *Edit inline* toggle exposes no pressed state (`aria-pressed` absent) in either mode.

## Expected

One Actions column (or a distinct, consistently styled header for the edit column); a row counts as modified only when a value differs from the loaded one; the toggle announces its state.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Compare against the loaded value before marking a row dirty; rename/merge the edit column; set `aria-pressed` on the toggle.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *inline edit duplicate actions column row modified without change aria-pressed*: 7 hits (0 open, 7 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *grid edit mode adds second Actions column header, clicking a cell marks row dirty with no edit*: 8 hits (1 open, 7 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#4647 (closed) — same grid inline-edit toggle; permission gating, not its pressed state or the extra column
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#2321 (closed) — prior grid inline-edit cell fix; different defect
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.
